dct_creator_sm: Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD).
dct_description_sm:
Original dissemination medium: cd-rom. 

Data files are in Beyond 20/20 format, which requires the installation of a free reader software. (https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/public/beyond20-20) Accompanying documentation is in MS Word & csv format.

Contains statistical series from several OECD databases. It provides an overview of economic developments of OECD countries since 1960. The tables mainly contain derived statistics such as growth rates and percentage shares. They include national accounts, population and labour force, prices, domestic finance and foreign trade.
